title: Claim
description: Output of synth-extractor. One claim = one assertion; verbatim or close-paraphrase from source.

id.description: Globally unique within a run. Renumbered by orchestrator merge step if necessary.

text.description: Verbatim or close-paraphrase of the source assertion. One assertion per claim.

source_uri.description: Path to the source file. MUST appear in manifest.inputs.confirmed (recursion-safety invariant 7).

source_provenance.description: Authorship context. NOT redundant with source_type — a regulator filing about a vendor product is source_type=vendor_whitepaper, source_provenance=vendor (the vendor authored it for regulatory purposes).

assumed_substrate.description: What substrate the claim implicitly assumes. Substrate phase uses this to flag pattern-vs-substrate mismatches.

date.description: Source publication date. REQUIRED when extractable; explicitly null otherwise. Per Design §7.4 success criterion 3.

entities.description: Empty at extraction time; populated by Grapher (synth-grapher writes back-pointers, not Extractor).

confidence.description: Extractor's self-rated confidence in the claim's faithfulness to source

notes.description: Free-form annotation; nullable. Per Design §7.4 success criterion 3.
